primary_result: The preregistered variance-only pilot completed all 32 canonical development scenes and 128 nested haze variants with every identity, grouping, keep/affine, no-training, and protected-data control passing. The scene-level continuous-utility error SD was 0.350329 dB. Its one-sided 95 percent bootstrap and chi-square SD upper bounds were 0.431961 and 0.444219 dB, so the conservative planning SD was 0.444219 dB versus the frozen maximum 0.127553 dB. Under the frozen normal-mean calculation, approximately 1213 independent scenes would be required for a 0.025 dB precision distance, while only 100 are available. The full continuous-utility qualification operation is therefore blocked for precision.
gate_reasons: All seven integrity checks passed: the direct parent terminal, complete source population, fixed hash selection, 32-scene/128-variant completion, keep and affine manipulation, isolated development role, no training, and no protected access were valid.
The conservative one-sided 95 percent planning SD upper bound was 0.444219 dB, exceeding the frozen 0.127553 dB maximum by about 3.48 times.
The bootstrap SD upper bound was independently high at 0.431961 dB, so the decision is not driven only by the approximate-normal chi-square calibration.
The frozen precision calculation required 1213 independent scenes for a 0.025 dB distance, exceeding the 100-scene development limit.
The pilot deliberately withheld the primary mean; no target-stability PASS or FAIL was computed.
competing_explanation: The result establishes inadequate precision for the currently frozen scene-mean estimand at n=100, not instability of the continuous utility target itself. Large between-scene heterogeneity may reflect the worst-phase aggregation, L-infinity action aggregation, genuine scene heterogeneity, or their interaction. Because the pilot was variance-only and published no primary mean or per-scene outcomes, it cannot distinguish those explanations. Changing the estimand, aggregation, margin, or uncertainty method would be a new Stage-1 measurement contract rather than a repair of this terminal.
limitations: The 32 pilot scenes are a fixed subset of the same 100 development scenes and are neither confirmation data nor additional independent evidence.
The primary continuous-utility error mean was withheld by design, so this result cannot establish whether the target error is below or above 0.05 dB.
The 1213-scene requirement is the frozen normal-mean planning calculation using the conservative SD upper bound; it is not a universal minimum for every possible estimand.
Haze variants, phases, tiles, pixels, actions, and bootstrap draws are nested or repeated measurements and cannot increase independent n.
This development-screening terminal authorizes no full 100-scene operation, Stage 2, confirmation data, NH-HAZE, training, model selection, or deployment claim.
